name: Yuan Cheng Cable Co.,Ltd.
summary: Operating out of Yixing, China, Yuan Cheng Cable Co.,Ltd. is a firm established in 2001 that specializes in the full lifecycle of wire and cable products, from initial design and research & development to manufacturing and sales throughout China. Their extensive product catalog encompasses power cables across low, medium, and high voltage classifications, in addition to a diverse range of specialized cables such as control, overhead insulated, mineral insulated, fireproof, bespoke, and nuclear-grade options. The company also provides cloth wires and other general wiring solutions. This entity, which adopted its current name, Yuan Cheng Cable Co.,Ltd., in January 2019, was formerly known as Recon Wenyuan Cable Co., Ltd.
